localChanges: Loading a save made much past the opening turns did nothing at all: the page did not reload, and nothing was said. A save is handed to the reloading page through browser storage, and it was handed over as uncompressed JSON — 1.6MB on turn 1, but 7.7MB by turn 130 and 11.5MB on a turn-110 game with more of a world in it — against a `sessionStorage` limit of about 5MB. The write threw `QuotaExceededError` outside the `try` that reports a save it cannot read, so the failure was silent (#5).

The save goes through IndexedDB now, which has no such limit, and takes it whether or not the browser can compress. A marker is left in `sessionStorage`, which is what keeps a save waiting mid-reload belonging to the tab that is reloading rather than to every tab on the site, and means an ordinary page load never opens the database at all.
A hand-over that fails now says so, leaves nothing behind, and leaves the game you are playing where it is.
